title: Engineer Software Defined Vehicle Simulation and Development
description:
NIKI is looking for graduates of Technical University Departments/Schools of Sciences/Engineers, or similar disciplines to support and develop complex system simulation processes of software-defined vehicles.

Become a member of NIKI Digital Engineering!

If you have completed your studies or doctorate and are looking for new challenges, interdisciplinary and diverse teams, and projects, send us your resume.

Our strategy is to transfer the know-how into practice. TWT is our trusted long-term partner, sharing and supporting our vision. Through close, daily collaboration, we design and deliver innovative solutions for clients and partners across the energy, health, and automotive industries. Combining interdisciplinary expertise in IT, digital engineering, and consulting, we turn ideas into impactful results that reflect our shared vision for progress.

What to expect

  • Develop and optimize process and simulation methods for complex vehicle development in collaboration with international industry partners and research organizations.
  • Continuously monitor industry trends and advances in simulation technology to improve NIKI's services and drive innovation.
  • Coordinate our interdisciplinary projects in close cooperation with our customers.

Task Description

  • Modeling and simulation of complex systems and software functions. Focus on areas such as driving dynamics and autonomous driving.
  • Active cooperation with our customers. Programming of functions and algorithms for modern vehicle functions. Accompanying the process from the first idea to delivery.
  • Forward-looking development processes. Functional and vehicle development using the latest methods and tools, such as graphic modeling languages.
  • Empowering and coaching our clients.
  • Protection of software functions. Efficient implementation of technical security measures and criticality analysis of software functions.</

title: Principal DevSecOps Engineer
description:
About the Role:

We are looking for a highly technical, hands-on Principal DevSecOps Developer to join Upgrade's Security team. In this role, you'll focus on building and improving security automation, strengthening our SaaS environment, and developing scalable solutions that enhance security operations across the organization.

You'll leverage your programming and scripting skills, hands-on operations experience, and understanding of APIs, IAM permissions, and security best practices to solve complex technical challenges. You'll analyze code, troubleshoot technical issues, and apply risk-based thinking to identify vulnerabilities and implement effective security controls.

This is a highly autonomous, engineering-focused role where you'll have the opportunity to build security automations from the ground up, leverage AI to improve workflows, and solve challenging security problems. You'll work closely with Security, Engineering, DevOps, and IT teams to streamline processes.

Our Core Technologies:

AWS (IAM, Security Services), Terraform, Python, Bash, REST APIs, AI/LLM Tools (Claude, AI Agents, MCP), Tines/SOAR, Sumo Logic, CrowdStrike, Okta, Akamai, Sublime Security, SIGMA/YARA, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD Pipelines, FleetDM/osquery, GCP, Google Workspace, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365.

What Youâll Do:

  • Build and maintain security automation workflows to reduce manual processes.
  • Develop and manage infrastructure as code using Terraform.
  • Implement AWS security controls, including IAM policies and least-privilege access.
  • Build secure integrations between systems using APIs and scripting.
  • Identify, investigate, and resolve security risks across cloud infrastructure and internal systems.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care with our innovative primary care tool, Counterpart Assistant. By supporting Primary Care Physicians (PCPs), we are able to deliver improved outcomes to our patients at a lower cost through early diagnosis and longitudinal care management of chronic conditions.

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to join our team. Our managers take on a player/coach role, balancing technical leadership, execution, and people management. The primary responsibility of Engineering Managers is to build and develop strong teams while ensuring high-impact results. We empower engineers to take ownership of problems and support them with mentorship, guidance, and business context.

As an Engineering Manager, you will:

  • Drive team impact by fostering high technical productivity and reliability.
  • Cultivate a healthy, results-driven, and collaborative team culture.
  • Represent the team in engineering-wide planning, initiatives, and processes.
  • Partner withÂ Product Managers and Designers to shape our technical roadmap and solve problems that improve the patient and doctor experience.
  • Set and communicate clear team objectives that align with Counterpart's company goals and roadmap.
  • LeadÂ hiring, development, and retention efforts to build a high-performing team.

You should get in touch if:

  • You have technical leadership experience managing teams of 3+ engineers.Â 
  • You have a strong background in system design and proficiency in general-purpose programming languages such as Python, Ruby, Go, or Java.
  • You have a track record of leading development projects while creating opportunities for others to grow into leadership roles.
  • You have experience in fast-paced environments, making quick, strategic decisions under competing cons

title: Traumpraktikum mit Perspektive: Werde Fachinformatiker für Anwendungsentwicklung (m/w/d)!
description:
TenMedia ist ein erfolgreiches Softwareunternehmen im Herzen Berlins. Wir sind seit über 14 Jahren auf den Betrieb und die Entwicklung von Individualsoftware spezialisiert.

Wir suchen ab sofort einen Praktikanten (m/w/d) im Bereich Fachinformatik für Anwendungsentwicklung.

Wir glauben an die Stärke und das Potenzial unseres Teams und sind stets bemüht, dass Beste aus uns herauszuholen. Als Praktikant wirst du Teil dieses Teams. Dabei folgst du unserem strukturierten Ausbildungsplan, der darauf ausgerichtet ist, dich innerhalb kürzester Zeit zum Profi zu machen. Neben dem Programmieren stehen auch Tools und Prozesse wie Microsoft DevOps, Scrum und Git im Fokus. Sobald du dich sattelfest fühlst, erhältst du erste Einblicke in echte Projekte und kannst diese erkunden und kleinere Tasks umsetzen, frei von Termindruck und Deadlines.

Aufgaben

Das erwartet dich:

  • Praktische Erfahrungen in einem schlagkräftigen Unternehmen, das sich auf die Entwicklung von Individualsoftware und Online-Plattformen spezialisiert hat
  • Moderne Stacks, kein Wordpress, Joomla o.ä.
  • Arbeit an spannenden Projekten und die Möglichkeit, moderne Technologien kennenzulernen
  • Integration in ein engagiertes und kreatives Team
  • Du kannst eigene Ideen einbringen und dich aktiv beteiligen
  • Lerne den Scrum-Prozess kennen und arbeite mit DevOps-Boards

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit:

  • Laufende oder abgeschlossene Ausbildung, Weiterbildung, Umschulung, Fortbildung oder Studium mit Schwerpunkt Fachinformatik für Anwendungsentwicklung, Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik etc.
  • Die Bereitschaft, neue Technologien, Programmiersprachen und Frameworks zu mastern
  • Erfahrungen mit Programmiersprachen, CMS und Frameworks (JavaScript, PHP oder C# ist von Vorteil)
  • Erfahrung mit Backend, Frontend, Datenbank, Versionierung mit GIT
  • Leistungsbereitschaft (!), Eigenständige
